findings.label: _poi_defs typed-array runtime crash
findings.description: _poi_defs is declared Array[Dictionary] but assigned from (poi_result as Dictionary).get('pois', []), which returns an untyped Array. Godot 4 throws a runtime type error on this assignment, breaking world generation on every new-game start.
findings.fix: Declare _poi_defs as Array = [] with a comment, or coerce the raw array element-by-element into the typed array.

findings.label: Variant-inference warnings unguarded
findings.description: var poi_result := JSON.parse_string(...), var biome_result := JSON.parse_string(...), and var result := JSON.parse_string(...) all infer as Variant with no @warning_ignore('inference_on_variant'). Earlier files in this project triggered 'Warning treated as error' for the same pattern.
findings.fix: Declare these variables as 'Variant' explicitly, or add @warning_ignore('inference_on_variant') above each line.

findings.label: Silent biome gap between outskirts and wilderness
findings.description: Effective distances in (4.0, 5.0) fall through to else -> 'outskirts' in _get_biome without an explicit case. Reachable with jitter ±0.25 on distance-4 chunks. Not a crash but intent is ambiguous.
findings.fix: Extend the outskirts check to cover the gap, or add an explicit elif for the (4.0, 5.0) range.
